verdict.rationale: First-party docs position Parse as layout-aware, agentic OCR that turns scans and images into clean text and markdown, and they also claim handwriting handling. That covers the core of OCR on scanned and photographed documents. However, nothing addresses the harder conditions the story names, and the only community praise concerns complex layouts rather than scan quality. Missing for 10: documented handling of skewed or rotated pages, stamps or seals, low-quality or degraded scans, and photographed (camera-captured) documents, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of OCR accuracy on scans.
